verdict.rationale: Ramp's reimbursements page documents a Google Maps integration for automatic mileage calculations, which covers map-based mileage logging. Ramp Travel documents a per diem that automatically adjusts to trip location and duration, but the evidence frames it as an allowance showing what you can spend, not a per-diem reimbursement claim. Both are single-line marketing claims with no employee-facing workflow detail. Missing for 10: evidence that per-diem rates can be claimed and reimbursed rather than only displayed as a spending allowance, a documented employee mileage-entry workflow (route entry, rate application, submission), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
